reviews.review: As a sci-fi and horror game fan, along with enjoying plenty of shooter games, this one really nails a lot of the things I like. Swarms, jump scares, teamwork, custom character builds, story elements, and explosions. It gives some Resident Evil vibes at times, but has some more action packed scenarios. There is a bit of chaos that is exciting when the swarms are coming to you. There is definitely a character and play style for everyone. The variety of perks, weapons, and consumables makes it easy to find the right vibe for your play style. There are a lot fantastic elements to this game and really shows the love the designers have for the Alien universe. I feel like a marine praying I don't die to an acid dripping xeno!

Fun game to play with friends. Great theme park style campaigns with solid action, combat and game play with a healthy dash of suspense and fearful encounters. 
Easy to use and able to jump right into the action.

reviews.review: Three player co-op stinks. We can play so many games with 4 players and this one cuts it to 3. So, it's not on our list of games to play or stream. Why do you think games like Left 4 Dead, Back 4 Blood, and Deep Rock Galactic are so popular? Four players! Come on devs, just open another slot and this will be perfect. But as it is, I can't recommend for co-op unless you want to alienate one of your boys.

nice game but would be better if more people played it, ended up doing the whole campaign solo with bots as I could never find others to help out or join in. Seeing what the game is like now the new DLC coming out seems more like a last ditch effort to save the game than actually decent content. Shame to see another game slowly die as it just cant get the player base anymore.
